author: Sentinal99
quote:
GTA 6 shouldn’t be celebrated, it is literally the embodiment of the downfall of the entire gaming industry.  GTA 6 is 24-26 fps on regular PlayStation 5 console.

There is obvious signs of woke bias in the game including not being able to bring weapons in to clubs or other enclosed areas.

There have been multiple reports of glitches and objects appearing randomly and flashing.  Characters falling through the ground etc.

The code not being present in the empty boxes.People stealing codes using the flashlight trick.

Reviewers being power influenced by rockstar to give the game perfect reviews (evidence available)

Paying a massive upcharge just for the complete game. $140 plus taxRockstar plus being rolled out as a subscription based item and location add on which creates a pay to win element. $10 a month.

Story is more like a life sim than a crime action sandbox.  Missions include getting groceries, walking dogs and fishing.

And the biggest reason why I’ll never buy this piece of ****, it has no physical media. 

Rockstar has made this an overwhelmingly easy decision.  Not judging those that bought it, but I can buy two amazing games for the price of this and have much more fun.
